            3. _lil.wen_, Jul 2, 2026, 4/5: "Love that it’s a native iOS app and not another web-based money app. It’s not really a budgeting app in the strict zero-based-budgeting way but it’s more of a money tracking and forecasting method of budgeting app. Great for conveniently searching up prior purchases and keeping tabs on where my money went but sometimes it double counts certain transactions and that throws things off, showing that I’m over-budget in certain categories when it’s really that the app was glitchy. Overall, would recommend for general money tracking/forecasting but for strict budgeters may want to use this along with a zero-based budget app like YNAB"
